title: Chicago pianist tells him never to change his style
summary: A Black woman pianist at a Chicago lounge advised him to keep his own style.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Lee, how about the woman pianist in the Chicago speak that told you not to change her style?

Oh yes, I was a guest at one of the cocktail lounges in Chicago many years ago and there was a colored girl playing the piano there, a very fine piano player. And they asked me to get up as a guest and do a number, which I was called on. And she told me to never change my style for nobody. And I had a different style and something good and unusual for me to stick with it.
